en.name: Carrot juice, fresh squeezed
en.summary: Freshly squeezed carrot juice keeps 6 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It is raw and unpasteurised, and carrot juice is low in acid as well, so it is not advised for young children, older adults, pregnant women or anyone with a weakened immune system.
en.pantry: No room-temperature timeline is given, and carrot juice is a particularly poor candidate for one. Unlike apple or orange juice it has almost no acidity to hold bacteria back, which is precisely why commercially sold carrot juice is either pasteurised or kept refrigerated throughout. Apply the two-hour rule without exception: more than two hours out of the fridge and it goes, or one hour if the room is above 32 °C. Chill it the moment it is pressed.
en.fridge: 6 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a clean closed bottle filled to the top, on a shelf rather than in the door. Cold is doing all the work here, so the juice needs to be genuinely cold from the moment it leaves the juicer — not left standing on the worktop while you make breakfast. Expect it to separate as it stands; shake before pouring. Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the bottle.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Carrot juice freezes well and this is the right way to handle a large batch. Leave headspace because the liquid expands, and freeze it in single portions so you thaw only what you will drink. The colour holds up better than in most juices, though the texture separates and needs a good shake after thawing.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and shake before pouring. Once thawed, treat it as fresh juice and finish it within the refrigerated window.
spoilage: Fizzing or foaming on pouring, which means it has begun to ferment.
A sour, yeasty or alcoholic smell instead of a sweet earthy one.
Mould at the neck of the bottle or on the surface.
A thick, slimy texture or a bitter, off taste.
tips: Get it into the fridge within minutes of juicing; the clock starts at the juicer.
Fill the bottle to the top to keep air off the juice.
Freeze in single portions with headspace for expansion.
A squeeze of lemon improves both the flavour and the keeping, since carrot juice has so little acid of its own.

faq.q: How long does fresh carrot juice last?
faq.a: 6 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Leave headspace for expansion, freeze in portions, and thaw in the fridge.
It is unpasteurised and low in acid, so it carries a real risk of foodborne illness. It is not advised for young children, older adults, pregnant women or anyone immunocompromised.

zh.name: 現榨胡蘿蔔汁
zh.summary: 現榨胡蘿蔔汁放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 6 天，−18 °C 冷凍可放 12 個月。它是生的、未殺菌的，而且胡蘿蔔汁本身酸度很低，所以不建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦或免疫力較弱的人飲用。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫的期限數據，而胡蘿蔔汁尤其不適合有。和蘋果汁或柳橙汁不同，它幾乎沒有酸度可以壓制細菌——這正是市售胡蘿蔔汁不是經過殺菌、就是全程冷藏的原因。請毫無例外地遵守兩小時原則：離開冰箱超過兩小時就倒掉；室溫超過 32 °C 時，一小時就是上限。榨好立刻冷藏。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏 6 天，用乾淨、密封、裝到滿的瓶子，放層架而不是冰箱門。這裡全靠低溫在撐，所以果汁一離開榨汁機就必須真的冷起來，而不是放在流理台上等你把早餐做完。放著會分層，倒之前搖勻。請倒進杯子喝，不要對瓶口喝。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月。胡蘿蔔汁很耐凍，大批處理就該用這個方法。容器要留膨脹空間，並分成單次份量，只解凍要喝的量。它的顏色比多數果汁撐得住，但質地會分離，解凍後要好好搖勻。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面上，倒之前搖勻。解凍後就當成新鮮果汁，在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 倒出來起泡或冒沫，代表已經開始發酵。
聞起來酸、有酵母味或酒味，而不是清甜的泥土香。
質地變得濃稠黏滑，或出現苦味、怪味。
tips: 榨好幾分鐘內就送進冰箱；計時是從榨汁機開始的。
瓶子裝滿到頂，讓空氣接觸不到果汁。
分成單次份量冷凍，並留膨脹空間。
擠一點檸檬汁，風味和保存都會更好，因為胡蘿蔔汁本身幾乎沒有酸。

faq.q: 現榨胡蘿蔔汁可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下冷藏 6 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。
可以，−18 °C 下 12 個月。請留膨脹空間、分裝，並用冷藏解凍。
它未經殺菌、酸度又低，確實帶有食因性疾病的風險。不建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦或免疫力較弱的人飲用。
